name: After Hours #38 — Coin Slot Storm
description: A glass room built for weather. The receiver dangles like it almost had news. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 38 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 3-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
